Paragraph: "In exploits Vali is an ingenious one... and the kings will be observing many aspects of their enemies to eliminate them... and they the kings are to be known even by ordinary people..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Respecting and fearing an enemy's intelligence and resourcefulness.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva acknowledges Vali's strategic intellect and ruthless capacity to eliminate foes.
Outcome/Resolution: He reinforces the need for meticulous counter-intelligence.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Shatru-Bodha (Realistic assessment of an adversary's cleverness and power)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Recognizing the subtle intelligence of worldly attachment (Vali) empowers the soul to seek higher defense.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Accurate adversary assessment: acknowledging a powerful antagonist's capabilities without falling into hopeless collapse.
